battle.create_stats.title: Battle Bridge
battle.create_stats.tab.board.hint: The ship at a glance: where it is hit, and what still works.
battle.create_stats.tab.setup.hint: The survey, the bow, the Section Markers aboard, and the alarms and outputs.
battle.create_stats.status.no_power.hint: The Bridge has no FE. It needs 150 FE/t idle and 600 while it aims guns. The board shows the last report.
battle.create_stats.status.fire.hint: Fire is touching the ship's blocks. Put it out before it spreads.
battle.create_stats.status.under_fire.hi: The ship lost blocks to a hit in the last 30 seconds. The Hits list says where.
Guns on Fire may fire by themselves at the target.
battle.create_stats.status.surveying.hin: The Bridge is reading every block of the ship to know what healthy looks like.
battle.create_stats.status.all_clear.hin: No fire aboard and no hit in the last 30 seconds.
battle.create_stats.hint.board: Hover a part to name it.
battle.create_stats.hint.board.ground: Hover a part to name it. North is up.
battle.create_stats.banner.text: %s blocks went missing while nobody was shooting. Accept them as a refit?
battle.create_stats.banner.why: No blast or hand edit explained these losses. If they were building work, Accept forgets them; if the ship was hit, Keep them as damage.
battle.create_stats.banner.accept.hint: Forget these blocks: the ship is smaller now on purpose. Click twice to confirm.
battle.create_stats.banner.keep.hint: Keep them as damage and stop asking about them.
battle.create_stats.empty.no_power: No power. Connect FE: 150 FE/t idle, 600 while aiming.
battle.create_stats.board.bow.hint: The bow is to the right. Setup says how it was decided and can turn it.
battle.create_stats.board.north.hint: Not on a ship: the board is drawn north up, as a map.
battle.create_stats.sections.label: Sections
battle.create_stats.sections.none_setup: None on board yet. Place a Section Marker in a room to give hits there its name.
battle.create_stats.sections.explain: Hits are named by where they land: bow, midship, stern, port, stbd, envelope. A Section Marker names a part of the ship instead.
battle.create_stats.integrity.label: Ship integrity
battle.create_stats.integrity.unknown: Unknown until the first survey finishes.
battle.create_stats.systems.label: Systems
battle.create_stats.system.hull.hint: Everything that is not one of the other systems: the structure itself.
battle.create_stats.system.lift.hint: Envelopes, levitite, burners and steam vents: what keeps the ship up.
battle.create_stats.system.propulsion.hi: Propellers, counted one each, with their bearings, engines, shafts and governors.
battle.create_stats.system.power.hint: Anything that stores or carries FE.
battle.create_stats.system.guns.hint: Create Big Cannons blocks, counted as guns once fire control finds them.
battle.create_stats.system.control.hint: Consoles, displays, seats, sensors and nav tables, this Bridge included.
battle.create_stats.hits.label: Hits
battle.create_stats.setup.survey_ship: %s, a Sable body: %s blocks, surveyed %s ago.
battle.create_stats.setup.survey_ground: A %s-block box round this console, north up: %s blocks, surveyed %s ago.
battle.create_stats.setup.survey_rule: Hand edits update it, unless the ship was hit in the last minute.
battle.create_stats.setup.survey_capped: Only the 65,536 blocks nearest this Bridge are watched.
battle.create_stats.setup.refit_banner: Last refit: %s blocks accepted from the Board, %s ago.
battle.create_stats.setup.accept_shape.h: Make the ship as it stands now the healthy reference. Every loss is forgotten. Click twice to confirm.
battle.create_stats.setup.box.hint: How much round this console the Bridge watches, 17 to 129 blocks on a side.
battle.create_stats.setup.bow.placer: Bow: the way you faced when placing this.
battle.create_stats.setup.turn_bow.hint: Turn the bow a quarter to the right. The board and the place names follow.
battle.create_stats.opt.bell: Ring the alarm bell on a hit
battle.create_stats.opt.bell.hint: Three rings on the first hit, then one a hit. Every powered Bridge on the ship rings.
battle.create_stats.opt.lights: Stage Lights on board follow the target
battle.create_stats.opt.lights.hint: Stage Lights on the ship turn to whatever the guns are aiming at.
battle.create_stats.opt.chat: Tell the crew about hits in chat
battle.create_stats.opt.chat.hint: Players aboard get a chat line for each hit and where it landed.
battle.create_stats.rsin.label: Redstone in
battle.create_stats.rsin.0.hint: A redstone pulse into the Bridge fires every gun that is ready.
battle.create_stats.rsin.1.hint: A steady signal means Weapons Free while it is on, and Safe while it is off.
battle.create_stats.cmp.label: Comparator
battle.create_stats.cmp.0.hint: 15 when nothing is lost, one step less for every 1%% lost.
battle.create_stats.cmp.1.hint: 15 for 10 seconds after a hit, else 0. For shutters that close when hit.
battle.create_stats.cmp.2.hint: How many guns could fire now, at most 15.
battle.create_stats.marker.title: Section Marker
battle.create_stats.marker.name: Name
battle.create_stats.marker.name.hint: Type a name: hits in this part of the ship are called by it. 24 letters at most.
battle.create_stats.marker.cover.hint: How far round the marker its section reaches, in blocks.
battle.create_stats.marker.reports: Reports to the Battle Bridge on %s
battle.create_stats.marker.reports_groun: Reports to the Battle Bridge nearby
battle.create_stats.marker.reports.hint: The Bridge names hits in this section after the marker.
battle.create_stats.marker.alone.hint: No powered Battle Bridge here, so the marker keeps its own record of its cube. Its lamp and comparator still work.
battle.create_stats.bridge.tooltip: A ship's damage board: where it is hit, and what still works
battle.create_stats.bridge.tooltip.place: Stand it on a floor aboard a ship, facing you; it needs FE
battle.create_stats.bridge.tooltip.usage: Right-click to open the board. It surveys the whole ship by itself
battle.create_stats.bridge.tooltip.shift: Every Bridge on a ship shares one record, so a Bridge shot away loses nothing.
battle.create_stats.marker.tooltip: Names a part of the ship for the Battle Bridge
battle.create_stats.marker.tooltip.place: Put it on a floor, a wall or a ceiling in the room it names
battle.create_stats.marker.tooltip.usage: Right-click to name it and set how far it covers
battle.create_stats.marker.tooltip.shift: Without a Bridge it watches its own cube: its lamp and comparator still work.
battle.create_stats.frequencies_back: Your old Linked Controller frequencies are back in your inventory (%s items).
battle.create_stats.tab.guns.hint: The target, every gun, and firing.
battle.create_stats.guns.no_target: No target. Pick one, or hold a spyglass on one.
battle.create_stats.guns.pick.hint: Every ship and creature in range, the most dangerous first. Click one to make it the target.
battle.create_stats.guns.clear.hint: Drop the target. The guns let go of their governors.
battle.create_stats.guns.fire.hint: Every gun on Track or Fire that is ready fires once, Safe or not.
battle.create_stats.guns.safe.hint: Guns aim but never fire by themselves. A salvo still fires them.
battle.create_stats.guns.free.hint: Guns on Fire fire by themselves when loaded, on target and clear.
battle.create_stats.weapons.by_redstone: Set by redstone: a steady signal into a Bridge means Free.
battle.create_stats.picker.none: Nothing within %s m. Ships and creatures show here as they come in range.
battle.create_stats.picker.again: Click again to target this player
battle.create_stats.picker.click: Click to make it the target.
battle.create_stats.picker.click_player: A player: click twice within 3 s to make them the target.
battle.create_stats.guns.none: No guns found. A Cannon Mount aboard, with an RPM Governor in the shaft into each of its faces, is a gun; a Fixed Cannon Mount aims with the ship.
battle.create_stats.guns.more: %s more guns than the list shows.
battle.create_stats.guns.problems.hint: What stops each gun, and how to fix it.
battle.create_stats.guns.rename.hint: Click to rename. Enter keeps it, Escape drops it; an empty name goes back to G1.
battle.create_stats.guns.aim_tip: Train %s deg, elevation %s deg, from the bow.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.open: Arcs of fire: click to open.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.close: Arcs of fire: click to close.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.train.hint: Training stops. Ticked, the gun turns only clockwise from the first stop to the second, never through the rest, and holds fire at a target outside them; the dial shows the arc while this gun is open. Unticked: all round.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.elev.hint: Elevation limits. Ticked, the gun aims no lower than the first and no higher than the second, in degrees above the deck, and holds fire at a target outside them. Its mount's own limits still apply.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.stop.hint: Moves this stop 5 degrees: + clockwise, - anticlockwise.
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.full_row: full, to the mount's own limits
battle.create_stats.guns.arcs.fixed: Fixed mount: the ship aims it.
battle.create_stats.mode.0.hint: Hold: the Bridge lets go of this gun, so levers, links and the VCC Mk IV move it.
battle.create_stats.mode.1.hint: Track: aims at the target and fires only on a salvo.
battle.create_stats.mode.2.hint: Fire: aims, and fires by itself while weapons are Free.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.down: %s's mount is gone. Rebuild it and set the cannon back on it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.down_at: %s's mount is gone. Rebuild it at %s and set the cannon back on it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.not_assemble: Power the mount's back face with redstone to assemble the cannon.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.hold: The Bridge leaves this gun alone.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.hand_aimed: %s's breech has a handle, so only a gunner in its seat can turn it. Wrench the handle off and the Bridge can aim it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.no_yaw: Nothing turns %s left and right. Put an RPM Governor in the shaft into its yaw face, under the mount.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.no_yaw_hangi: Nothing turns %s left and right. Put an RPM Governor in the shaft into its yaw face, above the hanging mount.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.no_pitch: Nothing raises %s. Put an RPM Governor in the shaft into either side face of the mount.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.two_yaw: Two RPM Governors turn %s's yaw face and would fight. Take one out.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.two_pitch: Two RPM Governors raise %s and would fight. Take one out.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.shared: One RPM Governor drives both of %s's faces, so it cannot aim. Give each face its own.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.no_rotation: %s's %s governor has nothing turning it. Start the engine or check the shaft into it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.held: %s's %s governor is held by another controller. Let go there or put the gun on Hold.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.held_vcc: %s's %s governor is held by the VCC Mk IV at the helm. Let go there or put the gun on Hold.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.overstressed: The line into %s's %s governor is overstressed. Add stress capacity; the gun turns slower meanwhile.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.aim_fault: %s does not turn when its %s governor does. Check the shaft between them.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.idle: No target. Pick one, or hold a spyglass on one.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.out_of_range: %s is %s m away; %s reaches %s m with this load.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.out_of_arc_l: %s is at %s degrees, below what %s may reach (%s).
battle.create_stats.gun.say.out_of_arc_h: %s is at %s degrees, above what %s may reach (%s).
battle.create_stats.gun.say.off_bore: Turn the ship %s and %s to bring %s on.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.blocked: %s is behind your own %s. %s keeps aiming and holds fire.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.blocked_play: %s is in the line of fire.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.blocked_surv: %s holds fire until the Bridge has surveyed your ship.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.blocked_far: %s holds fire: its line runs too far along your own ship to check.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_auto: %s has no rounds in its breech or its ammo container.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_big: %s has no shell or charge loaded.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.dry: %s did not fire: check its load (shell ahead of the charge, breech closed).
battle.create_stats.gun.say.safe: Weapons are Safe. Switch to Free to let it fire, or fire a salvo.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_no_cha: %s has a shell but no charge behind it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_no_she: %s has a charge but no shell ahead of it.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_dead_c: The cartridge in %s's breech is spent, damp or turned the wrong way.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_stuck_: A shell is stuck up %s's bore with nothing behind it. Clear the bore.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.empty_drop_m: %s is a drop mortar: it fires when a round drops in, not on command.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.loading_bree: The breech is open. The gun is ready half a second after it shuts.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.loading_sett: Loaded. Ready in half a second.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_overl: %s is overcharged: stress %s where it takes %s, so %s%% of shots would burst it. Take a charge out.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_barre: %s has a charge in a barrel block, and %s%% of shots would burst it. Charges go in chamber blocks.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_order: %s's charges would burst it as they lie: a big cartridge goes first at the breech, and only one.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_obstr: Something sits ahead of %s's shell (a second shell, or one stuck in the bore). Firing would burst it: clear the bore.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_shell: %s's shell is not whole or not in line, and firing would burst the gun. Reload the shell.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_under: Too little charge reaches %s's shell, so it would stick in the bore. Add a charge or close the gap.
battle.create_stats.gun.say.unsafe_unrea: The Bridge cannot read %s's bore, so it holds fire. Fire it by hand.
battle.create_stats.detail.error: Aim error %s deg, predicted miss %s m.
battle.create_stats.detail.gain: Learned: yaw %s, pitch %s deg a tick per RPM.
battle.create_stats.salvo.none: No gun is on Track or Fire.
battle.create_stats.designate.own: That is part of your own ship.
battle.create_stats.designate.no_players: Players are never designated by key or spyglass.
battle.create_stats.key.not_aboard: You are not aboard a ship with a Battle Bridge.
battle.create_stats.key.nothing: Nothing under the crosshair to designate.
battle.create_stats.spyglass.teach: Left-click while scoping to fire ready guns at the target.
battle.create_stats.setup.relearn.hint: Forget which way and how fast this gun turns, learn it again on the next target, and look for its governors again.
battle.create_stats.frame.title: BATTLE BRIDGE
battle.create_stats.slate.no_power.sub: The board shows the last report
battle.create_stats.slate.weapons_free.s: Guns on Fire may fire by themselves
battle.create_stats.slate.all_clear.sub: No fire, no hit in the last 30 s
battle.create_stats.jobs.title: TO DO
battle.create_stats.jobs.none.hint: A fire, a gun that needs a hand, or a place that lost blocks is written here, most urgent first.
battle.create_stats.jobs.foot.plan: The numbers are ringed on the plan.
battle.create_stats.jobs.click.gun: Click: the gun, on the Guns sheet.
battle.create_stats.jobs.click.place: Click: pick it out on the plan.
battle.create_stats.jobs.load.tip: %s has no rounds or shell. It stays on this list until it is loaded, target or no target.
battle.create_stats.jobs.gun.gone: That gun is no longer on the ship.
battle.create_stats.jobs.place.tip: %s %s: %s blocks lost. Any block put back where one is missing counts.
battle.create_stats.jobs.done.tip: Done %s ago. It stays struck through for a minute.
battle.create_stats.plot.title: MANEUVERING BOARD
battle.create_stats.plot.no_target: None. Pick one, or hold a spyglass on one.
